title: DITTO: Diffusion Inference-Time T-Optimization for Music Generation

layout.note: One wide left-to-right chain: noise blob at the left, the Diffusion box with an x_{t-1} box under it, x_0, spectrogram, f(x_0) and the loss at the right, a large Target Feature box under the right half; red dashed arrows run right to left over the chain and five circled numbers sit around it.

lesson: When the optimised variable is the input and not the model, draw the forward chain in black, lay a red dashed backward path with nabla signs over it, mark frozen parts with padlocks, and show the optimised input as a start dot and an end dot on a contour blob; number the steps so that the order closes back at the input.
